worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.summary: Releases acid around the user, dissolving one Pokémon held item and wearing down ordinary bodies’ held equipment through the native durability path (it can break). Allies are affected too.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.0: Dissolve nearby Pokémon items and wear down held equipment
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.1: Wear an armed enemy's equipment down to a break
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.use.2: Move allies carrying valuable items outside the acid before casting
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.descripti: Acid covers a %1$s-block radius; targets behind a wall are not caught.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.spread.on: Spread on: cloud radius x1.3 and cooldown +8 ticks, covering a wider circle.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.spread.of: Spread off: cloud radius x0.85 and cooldown -6 ticks, smaller but more frequent.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.timing: Cast around yourself; after %1$s seconds of preparation it costs %3$s PP, then %2$s seconds of recovery and a %4$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.growth.0: At level %1$s the cloud radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.growth.1: At level %1$s the cloud radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.preferenc: On: radius x1.3 and cooldown +8 ticks, covering a wider circle. Off: radius x0.85 and cooldown -6 ticks, smaller but more frequent. Area trades against cast frequency.
The companion considers the cloud only when the threat is within this distance; smaller means only at close range, larger means covering a distant crowd earlier.
Only when an enemy holds something

On: only used when at least one enemy inside the cloud carries an item, as a dedicated equipment-melting tool. Off: it fires as long as an enemy is inside, tainting them too. With either setting, it will not fire while an equipped ally stands inside the cloud.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to spray. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.corrosivegas.text.fizz: The acid licks by, nothing to melt
worldcombat.skill.corrosivegas.descripti: One Pokémon held item dissolves. Ordinary held equipment loses %1$s%% of its maximum durability through the native path and can be worn to 0 and destroyed; unbreakable items and items without durability are preserved.
